method: Manual screenshot inspection against official vendor references listed in research/desktop-fidelity-references.md. Different scene contents and viewports preclude a meaningful pixel similarity percentage.
improvements: All five home screens now have detailed raster wallpapers rather than flat geometric approximations.
System labels use bundled proportional typography; macOS dock, Windows taskbar, GNOME dash and mobile icon layouts have distinct geometry.
Desktop screenshots show independent overlapping windows, focused and unfocused controls, rounded frames and soft shadows.
Structured service pages use proportional typography, cards and sidebar layout instead of duplicated headings and monospace rows.
remaining_visible_gaps: iOS Control Center is a generic clock/application list, not the real grouped connectivity and media surface.
Many application icons remain original generic symbols rather than exact platform icon artwork.
Proportional service text wraps using approximate widths and can split words awkwardly.
Service-backed Mail is a generic structured page, not a full native Apple Mail or Outlook reproduction.
Mobile application content and system panels omit many native controls and transitions.
conclusion: Substantial visual and interaction improvement, not a pixel-perfect or photorealistic replica of every operating-system surface.
